name: Sheriff of Nottingham
summary: A bluffing and bribery market game where merchants smuggle goods past a rotating Sheriff.
rules_text: Each player starts with 50 gold and 6 goods cards. Two face-up discard piles are visible. Play proceeds in rounds where one player is Sheriff. Market: in turn order, each merchant may discard up to 5 cards face-down then draw up to 6, taking first from either discard pile (must take top cards to reach deeper ones) then from the deck, then placing discards face-up on a discard pile. Load: all merchants simultaneously place 1-5 cards face-down in their bag. Declaration: in order, each merchant hands his closed bag to Sheriff and must declare exactly how many cards are inside, all as one legal good type. Inspection: Sheriff, in any order, may threaten each bag. Merchant may offer bribes of gold, goods on his stand, goods in the bag, or future favors. Sheriff then either accepts bribe and returns bag, or inspects. If passed, legal goods go face-up to stand, contraband goes face-down (type hidden, count revealed). If inspected and declaration matches exactly, Sheriff pays merchant penalty value per card. If lying, declared matching goods go to stand, all other cards are confiscated to a discard pile and lying merchant pays Sheriff penalty per confiscated card. Pass Sheriff marker left. Game ends after each player has been Sheriff twice (three times with 3 players). Score gold plus values of goods on stands and bonuses for most/least of each legal good.
